enabled_by: #55. Until tools/sketch.py was deleted on 2026-08-31 the two tracks were built by compilers eleven years apart, so any cross-track site comparison confounded track with toolchain. One compiler per bench makes the track the only knob, and this is the first time this comparison has been possible.
means: Two tracks at one commit on one board with one compiler have essentially DISJOINT site sets: 1 shared bin of 30 in union, and that one only at FWS 4. This was run as a falsifier for 'the site set follows the generated code' - two tracks sharing a site set would have refuted it - and it confirms the model instead, on an axis nothing else reaches. Invariant 3 makes the two tracks different code by construction, so they are the largest codegen difference the project can produce.
not_claimed: Anything about severity. These are site SETS. And the ladder mixes benches: 0.885 and 0.154 are windows-desk's, 0.862 is cross-bench, 0.033 is this bench. Only the last is a single-knob on one board with one compiler.
